_comment: Former English strings of each key, rebuilt by `node scripts/i18n-stale-english.mjs --write` on a full clone.
--write adds what git history holds to the values here instead of replacing them: a string from a squash-merged branch exists only in this file.
CI reads this file. It does not walk git history: checks.yml checks out with fetch-depth 1.
enHash is the SHA-256 of the flattened current en.json. Change English and run --write in the same commit.
A value listed here fails the gate when a locale still equals it and the current English does not.

aerocrypt.intro.p2: While the overlay is active: your remote session shows contents in clear, every upload is encrypted, every download is decrypted. Look for the AEROCRYPT badge in the path bar.
aerocrypt.intro.p3: Difference vs AeroVault: AeroVault is a single self-contained .aerovault file (AeroFTP format). AeroCrypt is a layer on top of an existing remote (S3/SFTP/WebDAV/...) using the public rclone crypt format. Unlock with the same password you would use in rclone.
aerocrypt.title: AeroCrypt · Rclone Crypt overlay
aerocryptNative.defaultSaltLabel: Default salt (opt-in, password-only portability; requires high entropy and attestation)
aerocryptNative.intro.p3: This is AeroFTP's native overlay, on the same audited engine as AeroVault (AES-256-GCM-SIV content, AES-256-SIV names, Argon2id). The overlay's salt is stored in .aeroftp-crypt.json at its root on the remote, so you can reopen it from any device with just the password.
aerocryptNative.keyslotsF6Honesty: Removing a factor stops it opening the vault from now on. It does NOT re-encrypt your data: anyone who already kept a copy of the old vault header AND the removed credential can still open the data they had access to. To fully revoke access, re-encrypt the vault (rotate the Volume Key).
aerocryptNative.markerMissingRestoredBod: The remote marker (.aerocrypt.tsv) was missing and was rebuilt from the local keystore. Do not delete it again unless you switch to headerless — deleting it twice and losing the keystore locks you out.
aerocryptNative.noOverlayFound: No AeroCrypt overlay found in the current remote folder. Switch to "Create new" to make one.
aerocryptNative.recoveryKitIntro: Optional. This kit holds only public configuration (vault ID, salt, KDF parameters), never secrets. Saving it offline together with your password lets you restore a headerless vault after losing the local keystore (reinstall or new machine). You can reopen and save it again any time.

properties.checksumCaveats.b2-unverified: Large files and uploads B2 recorded as unverified carry no usable SHA-1.
properties.checksumCaveats.dropbox-conte: Not a plain file digest: a SHA-256 over the SHA-256 of each 4 MiB block. It only compares against another Dropbox content hash.
properties.checksumCaveats.s3-etag: The ETag is the object MD5 only for single-part objects that are not SSE-KMS encrypted; for the others it is omitted rather than guessed.

The ETag is the object MD5 only for single-part objects that are not SSE-KMS or SSE-C encrypted. A multipart or SSE-KMS ETag is never 32 hex characters, so it is omitted rather than guessed. An SSE-C ETag can be 32 hex characters and is then indistinguishable from a real digest, so treat a reported ETag as advisory for such an object.

The ETag is the object MD5 only for single-part objects that are not SSE-KMS or SSE-C encrypted; for the others it is omitted rather than guessed. An SSE-C ETag can still look like a digest, so treat one as advisory on such a bucket.
properties.checksumCiphertext: This file is inside the Overlays Path, so the server stores it encrypted. These digests cover the encrypted bytes and will not match a hash of your local copy: that is what encryption means, not an error. Use "aeroftp-cli crypt verify" to check the decrypted content against your local files.
properties.checksumNegotiated: This list is what this particular server advertised, so a given file may still have none.
properties.checksumServerSide: Digests come from the server; the file is never downloaded to hash it, so only what this backend already stores is offered.
